name: Irena-Viola Noxheim
original_name: イレーナ＝ヴィオラ・ノクスヘイム
source:
[quote]I am the First Princess of Noxheim, and upon that name, I will fight to the very last![/quote]

Irena is the First Princess of the Noxheim Empire, and no mere figurehead: she serves in the very army sworn to defend it. Proud and unbending, she holds fast to her own will no matter how the odds turn against her. Her people come before all else, and for the sake of a brighter empire she gives herself to the work without rest.

That same lofty devotion to freedom and equality wins her the love of the common folk as surely as it costs her the regard of the imperial nobility.

The gun at her side is a one-of-a-kind piece, forged with a Nox Crystal set into it.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.escude.co.jp/product/imperium/chara01.html]official website[/url]]
